_meta.description: Every ingredient line of every recipe that shows macros, mapped to a food in foods.json and an edible weight in grams, or excluded with a reason. Keyed by recipe id, then by the exact ingredient text. Editing an ingredient line in recipes.json means updating its key here; the build fails until it matches.
_meta.fields: food, grams (edible weight in the whole recipe); retain = share of the line that is eaten (discarded marinade); fatRetain = share of the fat that stays (fat poured off or skimmed); note = why; exclude = reason the line is not counted; skip at recipe level = no macros shown, with the reason
